answer: Yes, this is a real bug. Root cause: when a request is preempted (sim/batch_formation.go:preemptForTokens), its ProgressIndex is reset to 0 and KV blocks are released, but the decode tokens already counted in sim.Metrics.TotalOutputTokens (sim/simulator.go:executeBatchStep, line 650) are not subtracted. When the request is rescheduled and re-generates those tokens, TotalOutputTokens is incremented again — double-counting every decode token generated before preemption. The fix adds an OutputTokensLost field to PreemptedRequest (computed as max(0, ProgressIndex - len(InputTokens)) before ProgressIndex reset), then subtracts it from TotalOutputTokens in scheduleBatch. Additionally, ITL entries are cleared on preemption since they will be re-generated. After the fix, total_output_tokens is 105082 regardless of KV cache size (was inflated to 114630 with 600 blocks and 265 preemptions). Validated across 5 seeds x 3 cache levels with exact equality.
repro: ./blis run --model qwen/qwen3-14b --rate 20 --num-requests 200 --seed 42 --total-kv-blocks 600 2>/dev/null | grep total_output_tokens && ./blis run --model qwen/qwen3-14b --rate 20 --num-requests 200 --seed 42 --total-kv-blocks 60000 2>/dev/null | grep total_output_tokens
